A reference estimate, not a recipe measurement.

Food records describe particular foods and editions. Ingredients, preparation and serving size can change the nutrition in a real meal. Use the closest record you can find and enter a portion that reflects what you ate.

    Calculation: source kcal per 100 g × portion grams ÷ 100, rounded to the nearest whole kcal. It is a reference estimate; a recipe can differ.

    Two datasets, with their own terms.

    U.S. Department of Agriculture. FoodData Central records are published under CC0 1.0. USDA requests attribution. The catalog contains Foundation Foods, SR Legacy and FNDDS records. Read FoodData Central and its data-use guidance ↗

    U.K. CoFID 2021. McCance and Widdowson’s Composition of Foods Integrated Dataset is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0 except where third-party rights are identified. Each included row retains its main data reference and notes. Read the official publication and licence ↗

    Only numeric CoFID values are used; trace and unavailable values remain blank. CoFID alcoholic-drink rows are omitted because their values are per 100 ml while QikCal portions are gram-based. This guide is general food information, not medical or nutrition advice.
